title: Relative Spec commutes with base change
statement: Let $S'\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $\mathcal A$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_S$-algebra. The pullback of the relative spectrum $\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_S(\mathcal A)$ [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-relative-spec] to $S'$ is canonically isomorphic over $S'$ to $\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_{S'}(\mathcal A|_{S'})$.

mathlib_searches.query: relative spectrum of a quasi-coherent algebra commutes with arbitrary base change
mathlib_searches.results: No relative Spec base-change theorem; affine morphism and pullback infrastructure only

mathlib_searches.query: underline Spec_S A base change Spec_{S'} A|_{S'}
mathlib_searches.results: No bundled declaration; Scheme.Hom.pullback and relative gluing pieces
Mathlib has no relative Spec construction for quasi-coherent algebras or its base-change theorem
